name: qoder
description: Delegate tasks and reviews from Codex to a durable local Qoder agent.

interface.longDescription: Run Qoder tasks and independent reviews, manage background jobs, and transfer Qoder sessions into resumable Codex threads. Requires a local Qoder CLI installation and sign-in.
defaultPrompt: Ask Qoder to review my current changes.
Delegate this task to Qoder in the background.
